title: Every finite group as a free finite-index normalizer quotient of non-dihedral free products of cyclic groups
author: Rémi Bottinelli; Laura Grave de Peralta; Alexander Kolpakov
work: Telescopic groups and symmetries of combinatorial maps
difficulty_reason: After Kurosh and the named Schreier-subgroup correspondence are supplied, the source-local proof constructs nondegenerate colored vertex and edge gadgets with recognizable roots, and establishes unique edge-chain recognition under substitution. It then reconstructs exactly the original Cayley automorphisms, verifies boundary compatibility and freeness, and propagates prescribed arbitrary finite normalizer quotients through the cyclic-factor induction. The combined constructive graph-group realization and rigidity is substantially beyond qualification-level free-product subgroup calculations.
